messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: staged rollout v2.3.1 -> service: inference-api | region: eu-west1 | target: 5% | strategy: progressive (15m intervals)

alex: Heads up — starting the EU canary now. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.3.1 :eyes:

marta: Watching metrics. I'll post 1min snapshots.

deploy-bot: Health checks: passed (all pods ready). Traffic shifting: 0% -> 5%

marta: 1m: p95 latency 72ms (baseline 65), error rate 0.12% (baseline 0.08%)

sre-oncall: Noted. cpu usage slightly up on pool-a. tagging @eng-runtime

jamal: Can we hold at 5% for an extra interval? seen a couple of KV cache misses in the logs.

alex: Agree with jamal, extra observation window. Hold for 30m? We have a change window until 17:00 UTC.

chi: If we hold, we should pin traffic to v2.3.0 for fallback. Command ready:
```
/deploy pin inference-api --version 2.3.0 --region eu-west1
```

marta: 5m: p95 latency 85ms, error rate 0.6% (increasing), some 5xx from replica-7

sre-oncall: 5xx correlate with OOM on replica-7. Retrieving kube events.

deploy-bot: AUTO: Canary alert — error rate breach threshold (0.5%) at 1976549920

jamal: Recommend rollback to v2.3.0 in EU. Also haven't seen regression in other regions.

alex: Can we do a graceful rollback (drain + scale)? Ops prefers pin then shift back.

chi: Executing pin now.

chi: /deploy pin inference-api --version 2.3.0 --region eu-west1

deploy-bot: ACTION: Traffic pinned to v2.3.0 in eu-west1. Current traffic 5% -> redirected to pinned version.

marta: Post-pin 2m: error rate back to 0.09%, p95 67ms. Replica-7 being reprovisioned.

sre-oncall: Replica-7 OOM root cause: quantized kernel memory spike under seqlen=4096. Eng-runtime follow-up.

alex: Good rollback. Let's open a follow-up ticket and block re-rollout until a fix is in. Also add an eval suite for long ctx.

jamal: I'll create the ticket and assign to eng-runtime. I'll include logs + core dump.

chi: Noted. We should also update release notes with the rollback and reason.

marta: Going to keep the hold and monitor for 30m. Change window still OK.

alex: Thanks everyone. If no regressions after 30m we can discuss a patched canary with reduced seqlen or different kernel.

deploy-bot: Thread closed: canary pinned. For rollout resume, open a new deploy with controlled flags.
